release_notes:
BEVEL ANGLES PATCH 1.0

Fixes what the 0.8.7.2 build got wrong. Everything from 0.8.7.2 is listed below it.

FIXED IN THIS PATCH

  - 911 Inspection Dimensions read NOTHING in 0.8.7.2. It reported
    "no PART SKETCH pages found" on packets that plainly have them.
    Three parts of the drawing reader were missing from the installer.
    All three now ship, and the build refuses to run without them.

  - A reader that cannot start now says so, and the run stops -
    instead of quietly writing an empty report.

  - Angles read off the drawing got a length's tolerance (about a tenth
    either way) instead of a degree. They now carry the degree symbol,
    so the sheet picks the right one. Weld-prep angles were always fine.

  - A ".78" that lost its dot became a 78 inch dimension on a 13 inch
    part. A length with no decimal point is now thrown out - and listed,
    with what it probably should have been, so nothing vanishes quietly.
    There is a setting to turn the check off if you ever need it.

  - The run now ENDS IN A WINDOW you can read, with a Save as .txt
    button. It leads with what needs a second look, then what went on
    each tab. The drawing notes and repeated title-block fields are gone.

  - Picking the whole 911 QTDR folder used to start a run across every
    order in the program. It is now refused with a reason, and picking
    an order folder gives you a tick-list of its nests instead.

ALSO IN 0.8.7.2

  - 911 Inspection Dimensions fills in weld prep angles. The bevel code
    is on the drawing but the angle is not - it lives in the Electric
    Boat bevel book. All 947 sheets now ship with the app.
      - SB, FB and WB preps used to be skipped entirely. They work now.
      - A two-sided callout is recorded as two entries.
      - A VOIDed code writes nothing and names its replacement.
      - A prep whose sheet prints no angle goes on a "needs a decision"
        list instead of quietly writing nothing.
      - Clear-cut misread codes are repaired; the rest are named as a
        closest match, never guessed onto a form. Checked on 90 packets.

  - Pallet Stamper stamps the WORK PACKET, not the drawing binder. It
    was taking the first PDF in the order folder, which since binders
    arrived is usually a drawing - so the packet the floor reads stayed
    blank. Stamps left on drawings are removed.

  - Long folder paths no longer break file writes. Windows' 260
    character limit was making apps fail with a misleading "file not
    found". Fixed across all 25 apps.

  - FormingFinder tracks the same part built for two different orders
    instead of dropping the second.

  - Kitting prints orders of more than ten parts in full.

  - 911 LST Organizer accepts the nesting software's new 1D diagram
    format, which had been failing every run.

  - The Assistant quick note no longer jumps the cursor to the top
    while you type.

  - Apps that read from OneDrive download files while you are still
    answering prompts, so the waiting overlaps with the work.
